newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Inchon Iron sees 1.65 trl won '97 sales.
newsitem.headline: Inchon Iron sees 1.65 trl won '97 sales.

text.p: South Korea's Inchon Iron and Steel Co Ltd, a unit of Hyundai Group, has set its sales target for calendar 1997 at 1.65 trillion won, compared with about 1.51 trillion won estimated for 1996, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The company said in a statement it planned to invest about 311 billion won this year, compared 160 billion won in 1996.
The company's 1997 export was expected to reach $275 million, compared with an estimated $274 million in 1996, Oh Pil-jeong, a manager of the corporate culture team at Inchon Iron told Reuters.

After completing the construction of a new wide flange shape plant by the end of this year, the company will have an annual production capacity of 4.5 million tonnes, compared with the current 3.8 million tonnes.
